prompt: `pixel list-errors since --ts <window>` accepts windows in seconds, minutes, hours and days (`30s`, `5m`, `2h`, `1d`, or a bare number of seconds). Add two units: weeks (`w`, e.g. `2w`) and milliseconds (`ms`, e.g. `250ms`). Existing units must keep working, invalid or overflowing values must still be rejected without panicking, and both the `--ts` help text and the bad-duration error message must list the new units.
